items.title: Two Out of Five Failed. Now What? The Sense Behind Small-Sample Usability Results
items.text: This is a very fundamental question of UX Research. You ran a usability test with 5 participants. For a specific task, two failed while three completed. Now, the stakeholders ask “is it broken or not?” There are two wrong answers for this question: This is a 40% failure rate, we need to fix it. Most succeeded, we are fine. The issue is that two out of five is not a precise measurement. With 5 participants, the numbers tell you too little. It cannot be judged how common or rare this issue exists.
